input: Sword Art Online lineup synthesis: Kirito, Asuna, Kayaba/Heathcliff, Yui, Sugou/Oberon, Alice, Eugeo, Cardinal — tested against SC-SB-001 (exit sovereignty) and the bootstrapper thread (V4 Part 21.5, open question 4). See V5 Part 23.

shared_invariants.candidate: E — Exit sovereignty predicts moral sign (SC-SB-001)

detail.ASUNA: FIGHTS FOR (her own exit blocked by Sugou)
detail.CARDINAL: MIXED — keeps her own exit (library), took Lyserith's

shared_invariants.note: Every exit-blocker is a counterfeit in canon (Sugou; Kayaba before exposure; Cardinal's overwrite of Lyserith). Every exit-opener carries the genuine signal. Cardinal is mixed and is classified by act, not by side.

shared_invariants.candidate: B — Operates outside the sanctioned system
fails: SUGOU (abuses the system from inside its admin layer)

shared_invariants.candidate: D — Acquires power by absorbing defeated opponents
shared_invariants.note: SAO's power transfer runs by gift (admin ID, The Seed, Asuna's rapier), not by conquest. That absence is itself on-theme: in SAO the genuine signal is given, not taken.

bootstrapper_test.question: Does the bootstrapper entering the loop as 'the people' resolve Oneness vs Sovereignty?
bootstrapper_test.canon_run: Kayaba entered as Heathcliff but kept the exit lock and an Immortal Object flag → counterfeit (exposed by the HP tell). After defeat he gave his admin ID to Kirito and gave away The Seed → genuine.
bootstrapper_test.answer: Entering as the people resolves the tension only when the creator also gives up the power to block exit. Entry without surrender is surveillance from inside.
bootstrapper_test.status: SUPPORTED in narrative (not a real-world test)

domain_clash_matrix.mechanism: will exceeding the system after the privilege was dropped
Kayaba's surrendered admin ID outranked Sugou's hoarded GM privilege
rejecting the Church's authority; eye burst
family bond gave her a channel to act

most_surprising_clash: Kirito beat Sugou with Kayaba's administrator ID: the authority the first bootstrapper surrendered is what freed the second counterfeit's captives. Authority given away beat authority hoarded.

loadout_view.Gap: Cosmological scale — nobody covers it; consent and exit have no physical counterpart

octopus_mapping.reason: Cardinal is a subprocess, not a head, and the roster has two counterfeit nodes. The closer Octopus analog is The Seed: one engine distributed so anyone can bootstrap a world.

boundary_integrity.reason: Exit predicts moral sign 8/8 in canon (prediction passed within source)

corpus_completeness.reason: Aincrad, Fairy Dance, Alicization; later arcs (Unital Ring, GGO) out of scope

residual_mismatches: a story's moral sign is chosen by its author, so 8/8 tests the author's intuition about exit, not the world

outputs.uncertainty_statement: The 8/8 result shows the story's author shares the exit intuition; it is supporting evidence, not independent confirmation. Real-world confirmation for SC-SB-001 comes from attachment and addiction research.
